title: Malevolent Force Picks
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Malevolent Force · clips and music
heading: The Malevolent Force: pick a clip per shot, and the music
intro: Round 3, on your note: the setting stays the same and only the prices change, close on the bread. One still per option and one lightning clip; the new price cards are an edit of that same still, cut out and laid over the clip from the brightest flash frame, so nothing else can change. Shots 1-5 and the music (vibes1) are picked; earlier rounds are folded below.

groups.title: 6. Lightning, only the prices change (£5 → £50, 10p → £12)
groups.line: Close on the bread; the flash is at about 2.5 s.

opts.label: a: the end of the counter by the dark window
b: the freezer lid by the door glass
c: the window ledge, the bolt in the glass
opts.warn: a dark blurred shape sits in the glass behind the loaf (a reflection?)

sections.lede: Pick the lightning shot and the music.

groups.title: 6. Lightning, then the price changes (joined on the flash)
groups.line: The after still is framed a little differently from the before in each, most in a and c; b (the freezer) is closest, but its mist covers the price cards after ~3 s, so it's cut short.

opts.label: a: at the till, lightning through the front door; after, the till drawer hangs open
b: the chest freezer under the barred back window; the room drops to black after the flash; after, frost spreads
c: the front-window ledge, the bolt over the street; after, the streetlamp is out
opts.warn: price cards small in a wide shot

groups.title: The music: ambient, Silent Hill vein (instrumental)
groups.line: About 15 s; bells1 and bells2 ran long (2:08, 0:54), trimmed in the cut.

opts.label: bells1: Detuned bell-like electric piano, four or five sad notes, far apart (2:08)
bells2: Detuned bell-like electric piano, four or five sad notes, far apart (0:54)
vibes1: Out-of-tune vibraphone and bells shimmering against each other (0:15)
vibes2: Out-of-tune vibraphone and bells shimmering against each other (0:15)
guitar1: One clean electric guitar, wet spring reverb, slow mournful arpeggio (0:21)
guitar2: One clean electric guitar, wet spring reverb, slow mournful arpeggio (0:16)
foundry1: Struck scrap metal, chains and pipes in a vast dark reverb (0:15)
foundry2: Struck scrap metal, chains and pipes in a vast dark reverb (0:16)
radio1: Shortwave static and tuning whine as the music, a buried far-off fragment (0:15)
radio2: Shortwave static and tuning whine as the music, a buried far-off fragment (0:16)
siren1: A distant filtered siren wail over a throbbing sub-bass pulse (0:17)
siren2: A distant filtered siren wail over a throbbing sub-bass pulse (0:16)

sections.lede: Six shots in film order; the end card is text.

groups.title: 1. Establish the one lit shop on a dead street at 3am, and that something is awake in it.
groups.line: Still FO2-c. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: shop lights dip
a2: shop lights dip (second take)
b: streetlamp dies
b2: streetlamp dies (second take)

groups.title: 2. The force arrives: the front door moves with nobody touching it.
groups.line: Still PR2-e. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: door swings wider
a2: door swings wider (second take)
b: door swings shut
b2: door swings shut (second take)

groups.title: 3. Lead the eye down the aisle to the stockroom: the back room is where it lives.
groups.line: Still PR2-c. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: stockroom door opens
a2: stockroom door opens (second take)
b: basket slides

groups.title: 4. The loaf and its price, watched by a failing light; the flicker frames carry the price changes in the edit.
groups.line: Still PR2-b. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: two sharp flickers
b: slow brownout, bag stirs

groups.title: 5. Look for the culprit in the security mirror and find only an empty aisle and money on the floor.
groups.line: Still FO2-d. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: notes creep across floor
b: mirror rocks

groups.title: 6. The last frame before the end card: £50 bread at the door, the back room open and working.
groups.line: Still FO2-e. Pick the take for this shot.

opts.label: a: back room pulses
b: back door shuts

sections.lede: Instrumental, about 15 s (the Duration box read 15 s, not 17). Open each in Suno.

groups.title: The music (instrumental)
groups.line: Like the Black Ops 1 zombies "Damned" theme: pick one take.

piano2: Lone grand piano, fast repeating minor figure, deep reverb (closest to the reference) (0:17)

indus2: Distorted piano and down-tuned guitar chug, metal-sheet percussion (0:15)
techno1: Muffled techno kick through the stockroom wall, cold synth arpeggio (0:15)
